acceptance: A change under benchbox/ selects tests/unit/cli/test_output_control_static.py in make pr-preflight
Other tests that scan benchbox/ source by path are listed and either mapped or recorded as too slow for preflight
A test covers the new mapping
description: On PR #4146 a change to benchbox/core/equivalence/cross_surface.py added four raw print() calls. `make pr-preflight` passed; CI's medium tier failed in tests/unit/cli/test_output_control_static.py::test_no_new_raw_print_in_benchbox_runtime ('found 22, pinned to 18'), costing one CI cycle. The test scans source files by path and never imports the changed module, so the import-based selection in _project/scripts/preflight_targets.py (_source_dependents) cannot reach it, and SOURCE_GUARD_TESTS maps the benchbox/ prefix only to tests/system/test_module_size_thresholds.py.
